title: 2023-2025: Fresh Drops
desc: Recent releases, streaming wars & the artists dominating right now

questions.q: Taylor Swift's Eras Tour became the highest-grossing concert tour ever. Roughly how much did it earn?
questions.a: Over $2 billion — the first tour to cross that threshold

questions.q: Beyoncé's 'Renaissance' world tour and her 2024 album marked her first venture into which genre?
questions.a: Country — the album 'Cowboy Carter' (2024) debuted at #1 on the Billboard Country chart, making her the first Black woman to do so

questions.q: What connects Olivia Rodrigo, Billie Eilish, and Sabrina Carpenter in the 2023-2024 streaming landscape?
questions.a: All three are former Disney/Nickelodeon-adjacent artists who became dominant streaming forces — and all released albums within months of each other, fuelling a 'pop girlies' rivalry narrative

questions.q: SZA's 'SOS' album spent how many weeks in the Billboard 200 top 10?
questions.a: Over 30 weeks — one of the longest-running R&B albums in chart history

questions.q: What is 'Spotify Wrapped' and why does it go viral every December?
questions.a: An annual personalised summary of your listening habits — it goes viral because people share their results as a form of identity expression (and to judge each other)

questions.q: Peso Pluma brought which genre of Mexican music to global mainstream attention in 2023?
questions.a: Música Mexicana / regional Mexican — specifically corridos tumbados, a modern twist on traditional corridos

questions.q: What connects: 'Flowers' by Miley Cyrus and 'It's Gonna Be Me' by NSYNC?
questions.a: Both went viral for different reasons — 'Flowers' was an empowerment anthem after her divorce from Liam Hemsworth, and samples/references Bruno Mars' 'When I Was Your Man'. NSYNC's became a May 1st meme ('It's gonna be May')

questions.q: Victoria Monét won Best New Artist at the 2024 Grammys despite having worked in music for over a decade. Why?
questions.a: She'd been a songwriter for years (writing for Ariana Grande, Chloe x Halle) but only released her debut album 'Jaguar II' as a solo artist

questions.q: What is 'deluxe album' strategy and why do modern artists use it?
questions.a: Re-releasing an album with bonus tracks to reset streaming numbers and chart positions — it effectively counts as a new release week, gaming the Billboard algorithm

questions.q: Ice Spice went from a Bronx college student to a global star in under 12 months. What was her breakthrough track?
questions.a: 'Munch (Feelin' U)' in 2022 — it went viral on TikTok and led to collaborations with Taylor Swift, PinkPantheress, and Nicki Minaj within a year
